name: Segmented
intent: One choice from two to five options, shown as kit minimal Buttons side by side. The chosen one has a brand tint and border.
usage: Use Segmented for a small, always-visible choice that applies at once, like density, a view (List / Board) or a period (Day / Week / Month). It works like a radio group: one option is chosen, and arrow keys move the choice. Pass label (visible, or hideLabel), options and value or defaultValue. fullWidth stretches the options to fill the row, like in a menu. For more options or long labels, use Select; for an on/off setting, use Switch. See contracts/segmented.json for the full contract.

label.note: Names the choice. Visible above the options unless hideLabel.

hideLabel.note: Keeps the label for screen readers only.

options.itemShape: { value: string; label: string; icon?: string; disabled?: boolean }
options.note: Two to five. One or two short words each. icon is a leading Material Symbols name.

onChange.note: (value: string) => void. Runs on click and on arrow keys.

size.note: Heights 28 / 36 / 44, like Button. Without a size it is md. A surrounding Density changes these sizes through the density tokens (Default values shown).

fullWidth.note: Options stretch to fill the row. Each keeps room for its label; they share what is left.

name.note: Hidden input with the chosen value, for forms.

useWhen: Density or text size, a view switch (List / Board), or a period (Day / Week / Month).
A choice from a few options that applies right away and should stay visible.
doNot: Do not invent ToggleGroup, ToggleButtons, Segmented or a ButtonGroup with a pressed button. Options are already kit Buttons.
Do not use for more than five options or long labels. Use Select.
Do not use for on/off. Use Switch.
Do not use for actions. Buttons that do things belong in a ButtonGroup.
a11y: A radiogroup named by its label; each option is a radio with aria-checked.
One tab stop. Arrow keys move and choose, Home and End jump to the ends. Disabled options are skipped.
The chosen option adds a fill and a border, not only color. Options are kit Buttons, so focus shows the kit ring.
snippet:
<Segmented
  label="Density & text size"
  options={[
    { value: "compact", label: "Compact" },
    { value: "default", label: "Default" },
    { value: "comfortable", label: "Comfortable" },
  ]}
  defaultValue="default"
/>

examples.title: Density
examples.usage: Three options with a visible label, as in the account menu.

examples.title: With icons
examples.usage: A view switch. The label can be hidden when the screen already says what it is.

examples.title: Full width
examples.usage: The options fill the row, each sized to its label, like inside a menu or a narrow panel.

examples.title: Disabled option
examples.usage: A single option can be off; arrow keys skip it.
